xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4813: feat(models): support Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed

plan.title: feat(models): support Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Moonshot released Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed (about 2026-10-23). Overdeck cannot select or launch them on the Claude Code, kimi-code, or ACP routes, prices them as K3 if at all, and does not show them in pickers or docs.
narratives.Proposal: Register canonical ids k3.1-pro and k3.1-pro-highspeed plus native aliases kimi-code/k3.1-pro and kimi-code/k3.1-pro-highspeed across the type union, capability/class/fallback tables, PROVIDERS.kimi, the kimi-code and ACP alias maps, native effort translation, the cost table, and the Settings catalog. Claude Code launches with a platform key translate to kimi-k3.1-pro ids through a new KIMI_PLATFORM_MODEL_IDS map used by resolveKimiModelForEndpoint and a widened getClaudeCodeLaunchModel guard. The 1M context pin comes from the capability row. Docs describe ids, routes, effort and context. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4813.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing PROVIDERS.kimi.tierModels (opus/sonnet/haiku Kimi tiers)
- Deprecating K3 or adding it to MODEL_DEPRECATIONS
- Changing the launch model id of k3 or k3[1m] on any endpoint
- Updating kimi-code/kimi-for-coding metadata (K2.8 Preview)
- Adding a [1m] or 256K variant of K3.1
- Editing src/lib/model-capabilities.ts or raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap
- Any other provider's models
- Upgrading the kimi binary or running kimi login

autoDecisions.summary: Capability rows go in src/lib/model-capability-additions.ts, not model-capabilities.ts as the issue says.
autoDecisions.rationale: model-capabilities.ts is 1422 lines with a 1422 allowlist cap; lint-file-size.sh would fail and agents may not raise caps. The additions object is spread first into MODEL_CAPABILITIES, so behavior is identical.

autoDecisions.summary: Widen getClaudeCodeLaunchModel's guard to kimi-k2.7-code plus the K3.1 ids (not every Kimi id).
autoDecisions.rationale: The --model argument for Kimi is translated only there; changing resolveKimiModelForEndpoint alone would leave platform-key launches sending k3.1-pro. A narrow set keeps k3/k3[1m] launch ids unchanged (out of scope).

autoDecisions.summary: Platform-id translation applies only when the base URL equals KIMI_PLATFORM_BASE_URL.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's sketch translated for every non-coding URL, which breaks the existing 'does not translate unrelated endpoints' test contract.

autoDecisions.summary: Use live-verified native aliases kimi-code/k3.1-pro and kimi-code/k3.1-pro-highspeed with no PR-body caveat.
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator issue comment 2026-11-02 shows both in kimi provider list --json (kimi 2.0.2) with 1048576 context and low/high/max effort.

autoDecisions.summary: Settings modelCatalog.ts gets only the two bare rows; native picker rows need no static change.
autoDecisions.rationale: Chat picker Kimi rows are generated from MODEL_CAPABILITIES by settings-model-catalog.ts and expandHarnessRows; modelCatalog.ts has no kimi-code rows for K3 either.

autoDecisions.summary: Docs touch harnesses.mdx, harness-landscape.mdx, effort.mdx and docs/MODEL-CONTEXT-AUDIT.md; model-presets.mdx is skipped.
autoDecisions.rationale: model-presets.mdx lists no Kimi model ids; MODEL-CONTEXT-AUDIT.md is the source record the additions file cites.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep Overdeck display names 'Kimi K3.1 Pro (1M)' / 'Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed (1M)' rather than the CLI's 'K3.1 Pro Highspeed 2x Usage Cost'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the issue's stated names and the K3 naming pattern; quota cost is documented in descriptions and docs.

metadata.sizeJustification: Adding one model family touches every registration table it must appear in (type union, capability/class/fallback tables, PROVIDERS.kimi, kimi-code and ACP alias maps, effort, cost, Settings catalog) plus their tests and docs. Each table is a one- to four-line change. Splitting into sibling issues would ship half-registered ids: the ACP lockstep test, the capability-class completeness test and the exhaustive MODEL_CAPABILITIES type each reject a partial registration, and a picker row without a launch path is a visible bug. The 7 subsystems are breadth, not depth; the plan is already 8 small items with only two real edges.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4813.md). In src/lib/settings.ts add 'k3.1-pro' | 'k3.1-pro-highspeed' and 'kimi-code/k3.1-pro' | 'kimi-code/k3.1-pro-highspeed' to the KimiModel union, and prepend the two bare ids to the kimiModels available list (search `? ['k3', 'k3[1m]', 'kimi-k2.7-code'`). Add four one-line rows to AUDITED_MODEL_ADDITIONS in src/lib/model-capability-additions.ts (NOT model-capabilities.ts, which is at its 1422-line file-size cap), copying the 'k3[1m]' row's shape: contextWindow 1048576, effortLevels ['low','medium','high','xhigh','max'], costPer1MTokens 6 (Pro) / 12 (Highspeed), K3 skill scores with 'context-length': 100, Highspeed speed 88, displayName 'Kimi K3.1 Pro (1M)' / 'Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed (1M)'. Add four 'frontier' rows above 'k3' in src/lib/model-capability-class.ts. The union and capability rows must land in one commit because MODEL_CAPABILITIES is Record<ModelId, ModelCapability>. Write the tests listed in PRD WI-1 step 5.
